video_title: Alix Earle Invests in Cymbiotika, the Science-Backed Wellness Brand She Uses Every Day
evidence: Cymbiotika announced a formal long-term creator partnership with Alix Earle on August 11, 2026. The announcement states that Earle will leverage her TikTok, Instagram and YouTube channels, totaling about 14 million followers, to educate audiences about Cymbiotika, with potential for a co-branded product. Cymbiotika's official current creator page separately operates both an affiliate program and UGC creator program, including potential paid opportunities after ad testing. Qualified outreach contact: Vicky Evans, current Cymbiotika marketing and partnerships professional; public LinkedIn corroborates her current Cymbiotika role and creator/affiliate-program activity, while current organization data identifies her as Affiliate & Influencer Marketing Senior Specialist.
